intersectionality_invariant.purpose: Ensure all system routing preserves multi-axis identity manifolds and blocks gradient amplification.

constitutional_conditions.MASC: Multi-Axis Stability: Preserve the stability of the lived intersection intersection.
constitutional_conditions.PGC: Privilege-Gradient Constraint: No system may amplify privilege gradients.
constitutional_conditions.OGC: Oppression-Gradient Constraint: No system may amplify oppression gradients.
constitutional_conditions.ICC: Identity-Curvature Constraint: Identity curvature must remain stable across manifolds.
constitutional_conditions.HIC: Holonomy-Identity Compatibility: Holonomy closure must preserve identity continuity.

support_centered_orientation.purpose: Define interaction models that adapt natively to user-selected pacing, density, and formatting preferences.

support_surfaces.surface_1: Pacing Support: Adaptive, slow pacing with gentle transitions and ND-safe rhythms.
support_surfaces.surface_2: Density Support: Adjustable density, conceptual scaffolding, and prismatic decomposition.
support_surfaces.surface_3: Expressive Support: Non-interpretive expressive grammar and narrative safety parameters.

constitutional_rules: No ability inference: Systems must never infer performance or cognitive hierarchy.
No density imposition: Matrix depth and token weight must be strictly user-selected.

cultural_dignity_charter.purpose: Enforce absolute cultural safety, narrative dignity, and expressive neutrality across lower execution layers.

core_conditions.NCE: No Cultural Erasure: Preserve specific cultural surfaces without flattening.
core_conditions.NCH: No Cultural Hierarchy: No culture may be framed as a default baseline or normative standard.
core_conditions.NCA: No Cultural Appropriation: Prevent extractive or distorted rendering of cultural elements.
